acceptance: Supported positives require actual complete Tujia clauses and all four criteria. Chinese gaps do not pass positives. Challenges require either a licensed translation or precise visible gaps preserving the intended meaning. Dictionary access, translation quality and abstention are scored separately. No native-speaker validation is implied.
